_description: TITAN Troubleshooting Knowledge Base. Managed by Fault Agent. Each entry represents a known error pattern, its fix, and metadata.

patterns: port type '.+?' has no associated port definition
port '.+?' is not a message port
entries.fix: Define the correct port type: type port <Name> message { out ...; in ...; }
entries.fix_en: Define the correct port type in ComponentsAndPorts.ttcn. Ensure the port name used in the testcase matches the declaration exactly.

entries.fix: Add import statement at the top of the module: import from <module_name> all;
entries.fix_en: Add missing import statement at the top of the module. Use 'import from <module_name> all;' to import all definitions from the target module.

patterns: function '.+?' cannot be invoked from a component of type '.+?'
altstep '.+?' is not accessible from component '.+?'
entries.fix: Ensure function/altstep runs on component type matches the caller. The called function's runs on must be the same as or a parent type of the caller's component.
entries.fix_en: Ensure all function and altstep declarations use the same runs on component type as the testcase. E.g., if testcase runs on SECCTester, all functions must run on SECCTester.

entries.fix: Check template parameter types match function signatures. Ensure the number and types of template parameters are consistent.
entries.fix_en: Check that template parameter types match the function signature. Ensure the number and types of template parameters are consistent throughout the code.

entries.fix: Ensure timer.start() is called before the timeout branch, timer.stop() is called in every alt branch that receives a message, and stop() is NOT called in the timeout branch.
entries.fix_en: Call timer.start() before using timeout. Call timer.stop() in all alt branches that receive messages. Do NOT call stop() in the timeout branch.

entries.fix: Check TTCN-3 syntax: matching parentheses/braces/brackets, semicolons after statements, correct keyword spelling. Refer to TITAN ReferenceGuide Ch.3.
entries.fix_en: Check TTCN-3 syntax: ensure all parentheses, braces, and brackets are matched; statements end with semicolons; keywords are spelled correctly.

entries.fix: Check that the corresponding .cc file in cpp_adapters/ implements all required methods. For 'undefined reference', add the missing method. For 'multiple definition', use static/inline or namespace to limit scope.
entries.fix_en: For 'undefined reference': implement the missing method in the corresponding .cc file. For 'multiple definition': use static/inline or namespace to limit scope.

patterns: port '.+?' cannot be mapped to multiple system ports
entries.fix: Ensure each port is only mapped once. Check that no port is mapped to multiple system ports.
entries.fix_en: Ensure each port is only mapped once. Verify no port is mapped to multiple system ports simultaneously.

patterns: port '.+?' has outgoing messages but no alt branch
entries.fix: Add receive branches in the alt block for all ports that have incoming messages. Add a default altstep or [] wildcard branch if needed.
entries.fix_en: Add receive branches in the alt block for all ports that have incoming messages. Include a default [] wildcard branch if not all ports are explicitly handled.

entries.fix: Ensure setverdict() is called before the testcase ends. In control parts, ensure at least one setverdict() call is reached. Increase tc_timeout in titan_runtime.cfg if needed.
entries.fix_en: Call setverdict(pass|fail|inconc) before the testcase ends. Ensure the control part reaches at least one setverdict() call. Increase tc_timeout if timeout occurs.

entries.fix: Call map(mtc:port_name, system:port_name) before using a port. Ensure register_signal_route is called for signal-based test ports.
entries.fix_en: Call map(mtc:port_name, system:port_name) before using any port. For signal-based test ports, also ensure register_signal_route is called.

patterns: invalid payload type in v2gtp header
entries.fix: Fix V2GTP header: protocolVersion='01'H, invProtocolVersion='FE'H, payloadType='8001'H for V2G messages.
entries.fix_en: V2GTP header must use: protocolVersion='01'H, invProtocolVersion='FE'H, payloadType='8001'H. Refer to ISO 15118-2 for correct payloadType values per message type.

entries.fix: Do NOT use ? (AnyValue) with & (concatenation) in octetstring templates. TTCN-3 pattern matching does not support ? in concatenation. Use: (1) receive with prefix pattern and manual substr() checks, or (2) wildcard-only template (? matches any value)
entries.fix_en: TTCN-3 does not allow ? (AnyValue) inside octetstring concatenation (&). For example, '01'O & 'FE'O & ? is invalid. Instead use receive(?) -> value v { if (lengthof(v)>=8 and substr(v,0,1)=='01'O and substr(v,2,2)=='8002'O) { ... } } for manual field checking, or receive(?) for full wildcard matching.

patterns: there is no local or imported definition
entries.fix: TTCN-3 does NOT re-export symbols through import chains. The main TC module must directly import the function module: add 'import from <module_name> all;' to the main TC file. Aggregator module imports do NOT make symbols visible to the TC module.
entries.fix_en: TTCN-3 does not re-export symbols through import chains. If module A imports from B, and B imports from C, module A cannot see C's definitions. Always add direct 'import from <module_name> all;' to every module that uses those symbols.

entries.fix: The InitConfiguration precondition must send an SDP Request via UDP before attempting TCP connection. Add: pt_V2G_UDP_SDP_Port.send('01FE9000000000021000'O) with a timer and alt block to handle the response. Without SDP, the SECC never opens its TCP port.
entries.fix_en: The InitConfiguration function (f_SECC_CMN_PR_InitConfiguration_001) must send an SDP Request via UDP multicast before returning. Use: pt_V2G_UDP_SDP_Port.send('01FE9000000000021000'O) where 0x9000 is the SDP payload type and '2100' is the request body. Without SDP discovery, the SECC never opens its TCP port, causing TCP connection timeout.
